versions.subject: Merge PR #5220 from @netgrain - Add `File Access Of Signal Desktop Sensitive Data`
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4663
    ObjectType: 'File'
    ObjectName|contains: '\AppData\Roaming\Signal\'
    ObjectName|endswith:
        - '\config.json'
        - '\db.sqlite'
filter_main_signal:
    ProcessName|endswith:
        - '\signal-portable.exe'
        - '\signal.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: EventID=4663 ObjectType="File" ObjectName="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\Signal\\*" ObjectName IN ("*\\config.json", "*\\db.sqlite") NOT (ProcessName IN ("*\\signal-portable.exe", "*\\signal.exe"))
